entities.name: Kodolaag
entities.description: A Rakdos demon and poet-performer who falls for the effigy mage Zita, ends up imprisoned by Azorius and sets off a bloodfray riot at the Exner prison site.

entities.name: Zita
entities.description: A human effigy mage and shopkeeper in Rakdos territory who befriends Kodolaag, is arrested, and helps him break her out of Udzec.

entities.name: Olrich
entities.description: A frantic little devil who runs the Mockturne, Kodolaag's friend; he swallows the bloodfray amulet and impersonates Dovin Baan.

entities.name: Lucinka
entities.description: A former Azorius precognition mage who left after thirty-seven years and now runs a seer's shop, who guides the trio to free Zita and the prisoners.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate, mocked by Kodolaag and impersonated by Olrich.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos, who kills half the fans of performers who outshine him.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon guildmaster, impersonated by Olrich on stage.

entities.name: Lyzolda
entities.description: A Rakdos figure said to have many enemies.

entities.name: Jitka Wothis
entities.description: A curly-maned minotaur visiting her husband Grimbly Wothis at Udzec, framed by Kodolaag's planted whiskey, who later identifies the escapees.

entities.name: Grimbly Wothis
entities.description: A minotaur imprisoned at Udzec, husband of Jitka.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of demon performers and revelers that celebrates Ragefest.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law that surveils Rakdos territory and imprisons people, including for pre-crimes.

entities.name: Ragefest
entities.description: The Rakdos festival of carnage and revelry during which the story takes place.

entities.name: Udzec
entities.description: The maximum security Azorius prison, said to hold fifty thousand prisoners.

entities.name: Exner
entities.description: A new Azorius prison under construction with prisoner labor.

entities.name: The Mockturne
entities.description: Olrich's club in Derision's Peak where Kodolaag performs.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos guildhall and festival grounds.

entities.name: Derision's Peak
entities.description: A Rakdos neighborhood being encroached on by Azorius.

entities.name: Blight Parchment
entities.description: A weak effigy magic parchment used by children to torment others, that Kodolaag uses against an Azorius elocutor and guards.

entities.name: Bloodfray Amulet
entities.description: A wrought-iron amulet set with an amber stone holding bloodfray magic that triggers riots.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Kodolaag goes into Zita's effigy shop, is heckled by an Azorius elocutor outside, and clumsily tries to chat her up.
Kodolaag finally introduces himself as Kodolaag and learns Zita's rule that effigy spells on Azorius senators are now punishable by imprisonment.
events.quote: New laws in the skies last week. Effigy spells used upon members of the Azorius Senate are punishable by imprisonment.

events.summary: Kodolaag uses blight parchment to drive the Azorius elocutor away, and Zita fears arrest.
events.quote: He grabs his head with both hands, screaming at the top of his lungs.

events.summary: Kodolaag persuades Olrich to host Zita's effigy sales at the Mockturne by promising him an audience at Rix Maadi.
events.quote: I'll call in a favor. I'll get you an audience at Rix Maadi!

events.summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
events.quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

events.summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
events.quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

events.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing Zita.
events.quote: Visit Udzec tomorrow morning. Get in line behind the minotaur with a curly red mane.

events.summary: At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet, and Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis by hiding a whiskey bottle in her cape to distract the nullmages.
events.quote: Carefully, carefully I rest the bottle inside, hoping it's light enough not to pull the fabric.

events.summary: Kodolaag finds Zita under an Azorius spell that makes prisoners praise their imprisonment and realizes everything is not fine.
events.quote: The guards must be forcing the prisoners to speak fondly about their internment—or else.

events.summary: Zita brings a guard's drawing in a coloring book to life, and Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, incapacitating them.
events.quote: Electric magic ignites the paper, and the guards wail out in unison as if they're being burned alive.

events.summary: Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier, and the trio walks out among exiting visitors.
events.quote: Citizens! Behold! It is I, your highly esteemed Grand Arbiter, Protector of Justice, Purveyor of Protocols!

events.summary: Jitka Wothis and a vampire identify Kodolaag and Olrich, who are bound by magic; Zita escapes into the crowd.
events.quote: Before we can deny it, Olrich and I are bound up in magic.

events.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich are put to forced labor at the Exner prison site.
events.quote: As soon as we're given our uniforms, we're put to work with the rest of the non-violent offenders and pre-offenders.

events.summary: Kodolaag has Olrich cough up the amulet and scales the Exner scaffolding, shattering the bloodfray stone and triggering a massive riot as archons close in.
events.quote: The amulet cracks and unleashes a swarm of black tendrils, pressing the light back and turning day to night.

events.summary: Kodolaag joins the riot, and thousands of prisoners escape.
Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
events.quote: You'll have to set up new lives in the undercity,

relations.note: He pursues her, and they end together.

relations.quote: that son of a devil who I sometimes dare to call my friend
a hug that lingers long enough for me to wonder about the past shared between them

relations.note: She foresees and guides his actions.
relations.quote: Each of you possess skills needed to free the innocent.
Memories flash forth from my life before I'd found Rakdos

relations.note: He resents Azorius encroachment and ends up its prisoner.
relations.quote: It's maddening to see my community fall victim to order and justice.
with my best nasally imitation of Azorius's Grand Arbiter
until one day, Rakdos notices you have just a few more fans than he does.
